items.excerpt: An international team combined machine learning with quantum physics to identify two new superconductors, YRu3B2 and LuRu3B2, and built a much faster pipeline to screen candidate materials. The approach narrows a near-limitless combinatorial space toward the long-sought goal of a room-temperature superconductor.

ETH Zurich researchers built PLATON, a particle detector that uses light-field camera optics and AI to reconstruct invisible particle tracks in 3D inside a single unsegmented block of scintillator. Simulations suggest it could match or surpass today's best detectors while being far simpler to scale.

A BERT-based machine-learning classifier screened 2.6 million cancer papers and flagged more than 250,000 with writing patterns resembling fraudulent 'paper mill' output, published in The BMJ. Suspect papers rose from about 1% in the early 2000s to more than 16% in 2022, exposing a large research-integrity problem.

Technion researchers built BetaDescribe, an AI system that translates raw protein sequences into natural-language descriptions of their likely function. The tool aims to reveal the roles of uncharacterized proteins and accelerate drug discovery and biotechnology.

University of Osaka researchers trained a neural network on molecular-dynamics simulations to evaluate 16 competing structural descriptors of supercooled water. The AI framework pinpointed the most effective ways to distinguish water's two proposed liquid states, one of the field's stubborn mysteries.

Anthropic describes a hidden internal layer it calls 'J-space' containing words that steer a model's reasoning without ever appearing in its output, offering a new window into how LLMs think. The piece weighs what this interpretability finding does and doesn't actually demonstrate about machine cognition.

Google researchers built a reinforcement-learning system that continuously learns from quantum error-correction data to keep a processor calibrated while it computes. On the Willow chip it cut logical error rates about 20% beyond conventional calibration and made performance 3.5x more stable under hardware drift.
